name: jzt
description: A DOS-era Adventure Game for the Web

scripts.pregenerate-site: npm run prebuild && npm run build:game
scripts.clean: rm -rf build && rm -f src/metadata.json && mkdir build
scripts.prebuild: npm run clean && npm run build:metadata
scripts.build: npm run build:game && npm run build:editor
scripts.build:dev: npm run build:game:dev && npm run build:editor:dev && node task/build.js dev --development
scripts.deploy: npm version patch && npm run build
